# Purpose
This header file defines a generated seccomp BPF policy for `fd_bundle_tile`. It builds a `sock_filter` program that checks the runtime architecture and then allows only a fixed set of system calls with specific argument values, such as network, file, and timing calls. The policy uses the file descriptor values passed to [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_bundle_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_bundle_tile>) to permit access to `logfile_fd`, `keylog_fd`, `etc_hosts_fd`, and `etc_resolv_conf` only in the expected `lseek` cases.
